note: the best strategy after six take-profit rounds, which only moved the exit.

no_crypto.title: NO CRYPTO.
no_crypto.doc: Never opens a crypto position. The crypto basket lost 19% in the parent, about what it paid in fees: 25 bps a side is more than a 15m rotation clears.

no_rotation.title: NO ROTATION EXIT.
no_rotation.doc: A held name that drops out of the top two is no longer trimmed for it. In the parent that exit closed about 156 trades and every one lost.

no_distribution.title: NO DISTRIBUTION EXIT.
no_distribution.doc: No trimming on heavy volume into a down bar. In the parent that exit closed about 140 trades and every one lost.

hard_exits.title: ONLY THE HARD EXITS.
hard_exits.doc: Rotation and distribution trims both off: a trade ends at the stop, the momentum exit, the trail or the target.

strict_entry.title: STRICTER ENTRY.
strict_entry.doc: New positions need momentum z of 1.5 (not 0.5) and volatility expansion of 1.3x (not 1.1x): only strong, accelerating leaders.

one_leader.title: ONE LEADER, DOUBLE SIZE.
one_leader.doc: Holds only the basket's top name, at 80% of equity rather than two at 40%.

tight_basket.title: TIGHT BASKETS ONLY.
tight_basket.doc: Opens only when the basket's average correlation is at least 0.6 (not 0.3): a rotation needs a group that is really moving as one.

uptrend.title: UPTREND FILTER.
uptrend.doc: Opens only when the close is above its three-session (78-bar) average and that average is higher than it was a session ago. Momentum entries inside a falling trend are the classic losing trade.
uptrend.filter:
closes = [float(c) for c in context.closes(symbol, 105)]
    if len(closes) < 105:
        return False
    now = sum(closes[-78:]) / 78
    before = sum(closes[-104:-26]) / 78
    return closes[-1] > now > before

wide_stop.title: WIDER STOP.
wide_stop.doc: The stop moves from 3 to 5 ATR, so 15-minute noise shakes out fewer trades before they work.

heavy_entry.title: HEAVIER VOLUME TO ENTER.
heavy_entry.doc: A tranche needs relative volume of 2.5x (not 1.5x), two tranches 4x (not 2.5x). Fewer entries, each with real participation behind it.
